question: If multiple fission :: many cells, then binary fission :: ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**two cells**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Binary fission is a type of asexual reproduction commonly found in prokaryotes such as bacteria.
 
• In binary fission, a single organism divides into two parts, each of which develops into a new individual.
 
• This process results in the formation of two genetically identical daughter cells.
 
• Binary fission involves the replication of the parent organism's DNA followed by the division of the cytoplasm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multiple Fission:**

 
 
• A process where one organism divides to form multiple daughter cells.
 
• Commonly seen in some protozoans like Plasmodium.
 
 
 
• **Prokaryotes vs. Eukaryotes:**
 
 
• Prokaryotes are unicellular organisms that lack a nucleus, such as bacteria.
 
• Eukaryotes have a defined nucleus and include organisms such as plants, animals, and fungi.
 
 
 
• **Mitosis:**
 
 
• A type of cell division that occurs in eukaryotic cells, resulting in two genetically identical daughter cells.
 
• Involves stages like prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase.
 
 
 
• **Cell Cycle:**
 
 
• Consists of stages G1, S, G2, and M phase (mitosis) in eukaryotic cells.
 
• Ensures proper replication and division of genetic material.
